_envelope: All updates take {"data": [{type, id, attributes}]} EXCEPT update_quiz_question_banks (quiz_id top-level; item keyed by attributes.question_bank_id) and update_students (id OR attributes.email).
_PATCH_SEMANTICS: Fields use Python sentinel defaults + model_fields_set, forwarded via model_dump(exclude_unset=True). Omitted != null. Non-nullable fields are typed non-Optional so an explicit null is a type-level 422; genuinely nullable columns keep `| None` and accept null as a clear affordance.
_DEDUP_ASYMMETRY_TRAP: CREATE endpoints use FIRST-WINS dedup (later duplicates pre-marked duplicate_in_batch, never reaching the service). UPDATE endpoints use LAST-WRITE-WINS (every occurrence applied in order, each emitting its own update event) - EXCEPT update_groups and update_quiz_question_banks, which are first-wins. Do not assume one rule.

update_courses.failures: not_found for malformed/missing/cross-org/soft-deleted/DRAFT ids; internal_error for unhandled exceptions

attributes.title: non-empty when provided, max 500
attributes.description_html: empty string "" IS accepted and clears it - deliberate asymmetry with title/content_html, which reject empty
attributes.content_html: only valid on HTML lessons; setting it on a non-HTML lesson returns 400
attributes.quiz_id: only on QUIZ lessons; must be non-empty; NO null-clear affordance - a QUIZ lesson's quiz cannot be removed via PATCH

update_lessons._CONTENT_ITEMS_TRISTATE: OMITTED = children untouched. PRESENT non-empty = diff/reorder (item id present = update child, omitted = create child). PRESENT [] = DELETE ALL CHILDREN. Three distinct meanings for one field - the single most dangerous shape in the whole surface.
update_lessons._ORDER_COLLISION: Order conflicts with sibling lessons are NOT auto-resolved. A colliding value succeeds and BOTH lessons keep it; display order is then UNDEFINED. The description must say so.
update_lessons._readonly: Lesson `type` is read-only on update and absent from the schema; clients that send it have it SILENTLY IGNORED (not rejected).

update_quizzes._extra: forbid; service also guards with _ALLOWED_UPDATE_FIELDS as defense-in-depth for non-HTTP callers

attributes.name: non-empty, max 500 - the ONLY writable field

update_questions._ANSWERS_IMMUTABLE: Answers are IMMUTABLE on update - no `answers` field exists. Matches v1. To change answers you must delete and recreate the question.
update_questions._readonly_422: question_type, quiz_id/question_bank_id (a question CANNOT be moved between a quiz and a bank), and order are read-only - absent from the schema and rejected with a document-level 422 via extra=forbid.
update_questions._CROSS_STATE: A FLAG conflict against the STORED question_type (e.g. case_sensitive on a stored MULTIPLE_CHOICE) is a PER-ITEM validation_error inside a 207 - NOT a 422. The schema cannot see the stored type, so this validation lives in services.update_question.
update_questions.dedup: NOT de-duplicated - LAST-WRITE-WINS. Each occurrence applied in order and emits its own update event.

item_attributes.question_bank_id: REQUIRED - the natural key identifying WHICH assignment, not a writable field

update_quiz_question_banks.semantics: An empty attributes set (key only) is a NO-OP SUCCESS. A bank not assigned to this quiz is a per-item not_found. First-wins dedup on question_bank_id so QuestionBankAssignmentUpdated fires exactly once.

attributes.is_inactive: true deactivates, false reactivates - does NOT touch enrollments

update_students._IDENTIFIER: id (preferred) OR attributes.email as fallback. At least one required. When id is absent, email identifies the row and cannot also be updated. When id is present, email acts as CONFIRMATION - a mismatch is a per-item validation_error.
update_students._TWO_PATCH_RULE: To reactivate AND modify other fields you must send TWO separate PATCHes: first {is_inactive: false}, then the other fields. A single combined PATCH does not work.
failure_codes: not_found - student missing in this org
validation_error - anonymized/SSO/inactive guard rejected the update, or email confirmation mismatched
update_students._history: Replaces a single-resource PATCH /v2/students/{id}/ that was never publicly released.

attributes.name: 1..100, unique within org, case-sensitive
attributes.category_id: string|null - explicit null CLEARS the assignment

update_groups._NULL_MEANS_CLEAR: category_id null is meaningful. 'not provided' vs 'explicitly null' is distinguished by model_fields_set.
update_groups._identifier: id REQUIRED - groups have no stable natural identifier (names are renameable and not durable cross-call).
update_groups.constraint: At least one mutating field per item is required.

attributes.active: false deactivates, true reactivates - NULL IS INVALID; omit to leave unchanged

update_published_courses._not_accepted: course and domain CANNOT change after publish. slug is CREATE-ONLY and not accepted here.

update_web_packages._SILENTLY_IGNORED: type, state and base_path are server-owned; display_name is derived. A client that sends any of them has them SILENTLY IGNORED rather than rejected - unusual for this API, which mostly uses extra=forbid.
update_web_packages._DISPLAY_NAME_LAG: display_name only reflects title once the package reaches READY. While PROCESSING or ERROR the display name is the state plus filename, so a title change appears to have NO EFFECT until ingestion finishes. WebPackage.build_display_name behaviour, unchanged by the API.

item.id: obfuscated signup-field-VALUE id (note: create uses the signup-FIELD id)

update_signup_field_values._ID_ASYMMETRY: create_signup_field_values keys items by the signup FIELD id; update keys them by the signup-field-VALUE id. Different identifiers for the same conceptual row.
